## Review Report: Prevent Duplicate Fragment Title on Clone

### Executive Summary

The implementation fully addresses issue #11. All five files specified in the plan are modified. `generateUniqueTitle` is a clean pure function exported from `utils.js`, correctly strips trailing numeric suffixes before re-incrementing, and is imported and called in `copyFragment`. Both `editor-panel.js` and `mas-fragment-editor.js` now pre-populate `titleClone` on dialog open. All `node --check` validations pass. Six unit tests cover every specified case. One minor tech_debt was found in the folder-path filter (`startsWith` could over-include fragments from subdirectories), but this does not produce incorrect titles — only conservative ones. Full UI validation of the clone dialog could not be performed as the Studio app requires authentication.

---

### Issues by Severity

#### Tech Debt

**TD-1: Folder path filter uses `startsWith` instead of exact folder match**
- File: `studio/src/mas-repository.js:1019`
- Code: `s.get?.()?.path?.startsWith(folderPath)`
- Description: `startsWith('/content/dam/mas/en/studio')` would also match fragments under `/content/dam/mas/en/studio-extra/` or `/content/dam/mas/en/studio/subfolder/`. This over-includes titles from non-sibling fragments in the dedup set. The result is occasional unnecessary numeric suffixes (e.g., adding `-1` when the exact folder has no collision), not missing dedup.
- Recommended fix: Compare exact folder equality via `s.get()?.path?.split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/') === folderPath`.

---

### Plan Compliance

| Acceptance Criterion | Status |
|---|---|
| Cloning when title exists in folder → `{original}-1` | ✅ `generateUniqueTitle` logic confirmed |
| Cloning again when `-1` exists → `{original}-2` | ✅ while-loop increments correctly |
| No collision → title unchanged | ✅ early return when `!set.has(baseTitle)` |
| Original fragment title never modified | ✅ only `result.title` (the copy) is changed |
| Manual edits respected and deduplicated | ✅ `effectiveTitle = updatedTitle \|\| fragment.title` |
| `generateUniqueTitle` pure, fully tested | ✅ 6 unit tests, no side effects |
| `node --check` passes all modified files | ✅ All 4 files pass |

---

### Screenshot Validation Log

**Screenshot 01: `01-studio-auth-required.png`**
- Purpose: Verify Studio app is running on port 3000 and reachable
- Actual values seen: Adobe IMS sign-in page rendered (Email address field, Continue button, social sign-in options)
- Verdict: App is live. Clone dialog validation requires authentication — not possible in this automated context.

---

### Verdict: **PASS**

No blocker issues. One tech_debt item (conservative folder-path `startsWith` filter). Implementation matches spec fully.
